checks.name: phase_i_files_exist
command: test -f Source/UI/PercentileCloud.h && test -f Source/UI/PercentileCloud.cpp && test -f Source/UI/HeadroomHistogram.h && test -f Source/UI/HeadroomHistogram.cpp && test -f Source/UI/ResonancePersistenceMap.h && test -f Source/UI/ResonancePersistenceMap.cpp && test -f Source/UI/StereoCoherenceData.h && test -f Source/UI/StereoCoherenceData.cpp && test -f Source/UI/NoteRulerData.h && test -f Source/UI/NoteRulerData.cpp && test -f tests/AnalyzerTests.cpp

checks.name: cmake_lists_lists_phase_i_sources
command: rg -q "PercentileCloud\.cpp" CMakeLists.txt && rg -q "HeadroomHistogram\.cpp" CMakeLists.txt && rg -q "ResonancePersistenceMap\.cpp" CMakeLists.txt && rg -q "StereoCoherenceData\.cpp" CMakeLists.txt && rg -q "NoteRulerData\.cpp" CMakeLists.txt && rg -q "AnalyzerTests\.cpp" CMakeLists.txt

checks.name: percentile_cloud_q_and_dynamic_range
command: rg -q "Q_?10|Q10|percentile|Percentile" Source/UI/PercentileCloud.h Source/UI/PercentileCloud.cpp && rg -q "Q_?90|Q90" Source/UI/PercentileCloud.h Source/UI/PercentileCloud.cpp && rg -q "Q_?50|Q50|median" Source/UI/PercentileCloud.h Source/UI/PercentileCloud.cpp && rg -q "DynamicRange|Q_90|Q90.*Q10|Q_10" Source/UI/PercentileCloud.h Source/UI/PercentileCloud.cpp && rg -q "Frozen|frozen|History|2s|30s|scan|Scan" Source/UI/PercentileCloud.h Source/UI/PercentileCloud.cpp

checks.name: headroom_histogram_metrics
command: rg -q "histogram|Histogram|dBFS|dBfs" Source/UI/HeadroomHistogram.h Source/UI/HeadroomHistogram.cpp && rg -q "crest|Crest|RMS|rms|peak|Peak" Source/UI/HeadroomHistogram.h Source/UI/HeadroomHistogram.cpp && rg -q "clip|Clip|mono|Mono" Source/UI/HeadroomHistogram.h Source/UI/HeadroomHistogram.cpp

checks.name: persistence_coherence_note_ruler_present
command: rg -q "persist|Persist|excess|column|scroll" Source/UI/ResonancePersistenceMap.h Source/UI/ResonancePersistenceMap.cpp && rg -q "correlation|Correlation|mid|side|Side|mono" Source/UI/StereoCoherenceData.h Source/UI/StereoCoherenceData.cpp && rg -q "note|Note|MIDI|midi|f0|harmonic|tuning" Source/UI/NoteRulerData.h Source/UI/NoteRulerData.cpp

checks.name: plugin_processor_phase_i_wiring_and_quality
command: rg -q "PercentileCloud|HeadroomHistogram|ResonancePersistenceMap" Source/PluginProcessor.h Source/PluginProcessor.cpp && rg -q "StereoCoherenceData|NoteRulerData|AnalyzerQuality|Live|Studio|Analysis" Source/PluginProcessor.h Source/PluginProcessor.cpp Source/UI/PercentileCloud.h Source/UI/ResonancePersistenceMap.h Source/UI/NoteRulerData.h Source/UI/StereoCoherenceData.h

checks.name: reuses_spectral_analysis_engine_no_second_fft_owner
command: rg -q "SpectralAnalysisEngine" Source/UI/PercentileCloud.h Source/UI/PercentileCloud.cpp Source/UI/ResonancePersistenceMap.h Source/UI/ResonancePersistenceMap.cpp Source/PluginProcessor.h Source/PluginProcessor.cpp && ! rg -q "juce::dsp::FFT" Source/UI/PercentileCloud.cpp Source/UI/HeadroomHistogram.cpp Source/UI/ResonancePersistenceMap.cpp
